standard.summary: 焦点在 logSNR 空间的位置（σ = sigmoid(-0.5·logSNR)，故 0.0 对应 σ=0.5）。正值偏向低噪声端，负值偏向高噪声端；默认 0.0，范围 -3~3。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Where the focus sits in logSNR space (sigma = sigmoid(-0.5 * logSNR), so 0.0 corresponds to sigma=0.5). A positive value leans towards the low-noise end, a negative one towards the high-noise end; defaults to 0.0, range -3~3.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 焦点在 logSNR 空间的位置（σ = sigmoid(-0.5·logSNR)，故 0.0 对应 σ=0.5）。正值偏向低噪声端，负值偏向高噪声端；默认 0.0，范围 -3~3。

advanced_en.principle: Focus position in logSNR space (σ = sigmoid(-0.5·logSNR), so 0.0 corresponds to σ=0.5). Positive values lean toward low noise, negative values toward high noise; default 0.0, range -3~3.
